messages:
rachel: Lumen AI raised a dispute — Dedicated burst on their onboarding month. They say their onboarding agent misconfigured and caused repeated retries. Can someone check attribution and advise if we should absorb?

omar: Invoice ref?

rachel: Invoice 2026-07-02 line: DEDICATED_BURST $4,600. They sent logs showing a retry storm from their side between 2026-06-28 02:00-03:20.

billing-bot: Auto: Invoice 2026-07-02 for account lumen-ai (acct_9999). Line items:
``nDEDICATED_COMMIT_MONTHLY 1 $15,000.00
DEDICATED_BURST 1 $4,600.00 (2026-06-28 02:05 - 2026-06-28 03:15)
```

tessa: I pulled pool logs. Sample:
``n2026-06-28T02:05:10Z host-48 req=rq1001 tokens=22000 tenant=acct_9999 retry=true
2026-06-28T02:05:11Z host-48 req=rq1002 tokens=21000 tenant=acct_9999 retry=true
```
Appears majority from lumen's tenant and client-side retries.

omar: Any cross-tenant spill?

tessa: No — no other tenant traffic in that window. This is self-originating.

rachel: Lumen asks if we can waive the burst as a one-time onboarding courtesy and whether to adjust their commit. They also offer to sign an onboarding best-practices addendum (pricing experiment: 1-month waiver for new customers who sign).

omar: Finance note: waiving entire $4,600 sets a precedent. Suggest: 50% waiver ($2,300) as goodwill if they sign the addendum and activate request rate limits on SDK. Remaining $2,300 billed.

tessa: Ops: we should document the retry detection rule and auto-throttle after N retries to protect Dedicated pools. I'll open infra ticket. infra-bot: alert onboarding-retry-throttle-2026-06 created.

rachel: Lumen accepted 50/50 split and will sign addendum. Proceed with credit memo $2,300.

billing-bot: Action: credit memo CM-2026-07-LUM-01 issued for $2,300.00; invoice 2026-07-02-v2 created with adjusted burst line $2,300.00.

omar: Recording this as an approved pricing experiment: onboarding-waiver-50pct. Pri: low, duration: 90 days.

tessa: I'll include retry detection in postmortem and add a follow-up that prevents future onboarding storms.

rachel: Closing thread — Lumen confirmed and appreciated the compromise.
